description: Xavante-type monument inside the base. Aviação em Floripa (2025) states the Porto Velho airframe is an ex-SAAF Atlas Impala Mk.1 wearing fictitious serial 4460; aviagraphers earlier read it as 4478 and called it an 'alleged MB.326M'; ABRAPAC 2019 listed 4570 and the Feb 2026 list 4578. Identity unresolved.
museum_name: Base Aérea de Porto Velho AT-26 Display
